found_by: coordinator, when merging the four returned cohorts into the integration branch and running the combined suite
defect: Two cohorts wrote tests asserting that a recorded snapshot of live, mutating shared state equals a fresh recomputation of that state. Those tests pass at the moment they are written and are then guaranteed to fail as the wave progresses, because the state they measure keeps changing. They are the mirror image of a false green: a false red, which is just as corrosive to an acceptance gate because it trains a reader to discount failures.
why_it_matters: The commission requires that a fresh checkout reproduce the complete suite and that escaped-defect and false-green rates be measured. A suite containing snapshot-equality assertions over mutating shared state cannot serve as a stable acceptance gate, and it cannot distinguish a real regression from ordinary wave progress.
root_cause: The same snapshot-versus-live coupling that cohort a9 itself discovered in the dispatch source capsule. a9 identified the defect in the coordinator's pinning primitive and then reproduced it in its own test suite. The lesson generalises: any assertion over shared mutating state must either pin the state by immutable commit or assert an invariant rather than a value.

observed_failures.cause: a6 recorded a unit's result as UNAVAILABLE because the producing branch was not yet pushed at its scoring time. That result has since been pushed, so the audit correctly now reports AUDITED. The test asserts the snapshot value, so it fails precisely because reality improved.
observed_failures.underlying_property_worth_asserting: that a missing result is never invented, which is the actual intent and is invariant

observed_failures.cause: a9 recorded aggregate_state DRIFTED with a specific drift set. Additional dispatches and further coordinator repairs have since changed that set, so the recomputation no longer equals the recorded report.
observed_failures.underlying_property_worth_asserting: that drift is detected and classified, and that the classifier is deterministic for a fixed input capsule

observed_failures.cause: same class: asserts a recorded challenge artifact reproduces against current committed evidence, which has moved.
same class: asserts recorded semantic-check results reproduce against the current pointer chain and unit population, which has grown from 74 to 87 registered units.
same class: depends on the recorded run snapshot rather than on the invariant.

integration_branch_suite_state.result: FAILED (failures=5, expected failures=8) out of 137 tests
integration_branch_suite_state.honest_reading: The integration branch does not currently pass its own suite. The five failures are the snapshot-coupling class described here and none is a real regression. The eight expected failures are cohort a2's frozen reproductions of open control-plane defects and are supposed to fail until cohort a11 lands its remediation. Reporting a green suite at this checkpoint would be false.

remediation.routing: The failing tests are owned by cohorts a6 and a9. The coordinator does not edit another cohort's paths, so both cohorts were resumed with the specific defect and the required fix rather than having their tests rewritten across an ownership boundary.
remediation.required_fix: Replace snapshot-equality assertions over mutating shared state with either an invariant assertion, or an assertion pinned to the immutable commit at which the snapshot was computed, so the test remains meaningful and stays true as the wave progresses.

coordinator_defect_found_in_the_same_pas.defect: Tracked generated bytecode in the repository: four .pyc files under workstreams/po03/tests/__pycache__ and workstreams/po03/tools/__pycache__.
coordinator_defect_found_in_the_same_pas.originally_reported_by: po03-worker-a6, unit a6-u04, recorded as ESCAPE_FOUND against the clean-clone claim and attributed to cohort a3
coordinator_defect_found_in_the_same_pas.true_origin: The coordinator. Introduced by commits 04827c3 and 6f5e386, where a broad `git add -A` swept up bytecode generated by running the test suite. Cohort a3 branched from the coordinator and inherited the files, which is why the reviewer attributed them to a3.
coordinator_defect_found_in_the_same_pas.significance: The reviewer's finding was correct and its attribution was wrong. The escape it identified against the clean-clone and byte-determinism claims was real: committed bytecode makes a tree non-reproducible and can shadow a source change.
coordinator_defect_found_in_the_same_pas.repair: Removed all four files from the index and added workstreams/po03/.gitignore covering __pycache__, *.pyc and *.pyo so the sweep cannot recur inside the allowlist.
coordinator_defect_found_in_the_same_pas.verified: git ls-files reports zero tracked bytecode.
coordinator_defect_found_in_the_same_pas.lesson: A broad `git add -A` is unsafe for a writer that also runs the code it commits. This is recorded as a lesson for the successor-generation comparison, not only as a fix.

merge_integrity_observation.claim: Disjoint per-owner subtrees prevent write collisions between concurrent subordinates.
merge_integrity_observation.test: Four independently developed cohort branches (a2, a4, a6, a9) were merged into the integration branch in sequence.
merge_integrity_observation.result: All four merged with zero conflicts.
merge_integrity_observation.interpretation: This is direct evidence for the ownership design and it corroborates cohort a9's upheld assumption that disjoint ownership prefixes structurally prevent worker-path collisions. A conflict would itself have been the signal of an ownership violation, so the clean merge is the positive result rather than merely an absence of trouble.

escalation.to: SYSTEMIC_DEFECT_CLASS — the most replicated finding of Wave A

po03-worker-a9 (gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh): four tests, all fixed by pinning to immutable commits
coordinator (claude-opus-5-thinking-max): source-capsule-drift.json recorded a current hash that was stale in the commit that introduced it

escalation.why_this_is_not_carelessness: Cohort a7 explicitly reported having already fixed this staleness twice in its own artifacts during its session, and still shipped two tests with the same coupling. Cohort a9 discovered the defect class in the coordinator's dispatch capsule and then reproduced it in four of its own tests. The coordinator reproduced it inside the very document written to describe it. Four independent frontier configurations, each warned or self-aware, all produced it. That is a property of the primitive, not a property of the writers: asserting equality between a recorded snapshot and a live recomputation is simply unsound whenever the measured state can change, and it fails in the direction that looks like a regression.
escalation.generalised_root_cause: Identical to the source-capsule defect. A hash or value taken from mutable shared state is not a pin. Only (path, blob SHA, commit SHA) or a ledger head hash is a pin.

binding_operating_rule.rule: Any PO-03 test or report that derives a value from shared mutating state — the ledger, the unit population, the pointer chain, another cohort's branch — must either assert an invariant, or assert reproduction at an explicitly recorded immutable pin: a commit SHA for files, or the ledger head row_sha256 for ledger-derived values.
binding_operating_rule.never: Assert that a recomputation against live state equals a previously committed record.
binding_operating_rule.also_never: Assert that a defect currently exists, because the test then fails when the defect is fixed. Assert instead that the detector flags a synthetic instance.
binding_operating_rule.enforcement: a6's mutation-based false-green detector plus review; a candidate for a mechanical check in a successor generation

escalation.why_the_fix_is_cheap_here: Cohort a7 already records the exact ledger head it measured against, row_sha256 1db35dd1b4daa67da32f3bb0fffb4998890d435db05cbd6a930480f0c5804fa0 at 319 rows. Its two failing tests can assert reproduction at that recorded head rather than against the live ledger, which is a small change that makes the assertion permanently true and still falsifiable.
escalation.successor_relevance: This is the strongest candidate for a lesson that changes a live mechanism in the G2 successor, because it is independently replicated across four model families and has a concrete mechanical remedy.
